_comment: Drives the StarWave Wizard menu. Add a build or layout here and every device picks it up with no add-on update. Personal builds must never contain credentials - a Kodi repository has to be publicly readable.

builds.name: StarWave v4 (clean)
builds.description: The stock StarWave build, version 4 - skin, home menu, widgets, Live TV Guide, Sports Hub, and 108 add-ons. It carries no personal configuration and no credentials, and leaves audio and display at Kodi defaults so it works on any device. Choose Update to keep your own settings and logins, or Fresh Install to reset them.

builds.name: STRFCK3R v4 (personal)
builds.description: STRFCK3R personal configuration with custom layout and settings. Sign in to your own services via Trakt > Setup.

layouts.name: StarWave
layouts.description: The original StarWave layout: Trakt, Movies, Shows, Settings and Quit, with the Aura wallpaper rotation.

layouts.name: Arctic Fuse
layouts.description: Arctic Fuse 3, with home rows built from your Trakt lists and a submenu for the source add-ons. Downloads the skin if this device does not have it.
